overview: DIVA-GRPO dynamically assesses problem difficulty, adaptively generates semantic-consistent variants with controlled difficulty levels, and computes difficulty-weighted local-global advantages with reward-range rescaling to mitigate reward sparsity and advantage vanishing in GRPO-based multimodal reasoning.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Centralized management of all experiment hyperparameters including difficulty range, learning rate, sensitivity parameter, normalization settings, variant counts, rollout counts, and benchmark configurations via structured config files.

modules.name: Data Loading & Preprocessing
modules.description: Loading and formatting multimodal math reasoning datasets (MathVista, MathVerse, MathVision, OlympiadBench, WeMath, MMK12) with paired image-text inputs and ground-truth answers, handling format conversion and answer extraction.

modules.name: Dynamic Difficulty Assessment
modules.description: Iterative problem difficulty scoring mechanism that initializes difficulty at the midpoint and updates based on historical rollout accuracy using a clipping function, ensuring difficulty evolves with model capability across training epochs.

modules.name: Text Variant Generation
modules.description: Generation of semantically equivalent textual reformulations of original questions through rephrasing, restructuring, and linguistic perturbation while preserving the ground-truth answer, used for moderate-difficulty problems.

modules.name: Image Variant Generation
modules.description: Application of visual perturbations including Gaussian noise, salt-and-pepper noise, speckle noise, blurring, and rotation to original images, as well as embedding textual information into images, used to increase difficulty for easy problems.

modules.name: Think-Step Variant Generation
modules.description: Generation of partial intermediate reasoning step hints via an external model, appended to difficult problems to provide guided reasoning scaffolding while preserving the original answer.

modules.name: Difficulty-Adaptive Variant Sampling
modules.description: Strategy that selects variant types based on assessed difficulty: easy problems receive image+text perturbations, moderate problems receive text paraphrases, and hard problems receive think-step hints, sampling from a normal distribution centered on the target difficulty level.

modules.name: Multimodal Variant Dataset & DataLoader
modules.description: Custom PyTorch Dataset and DataLoader that manage original problems alongside their dynamically generated variant sets, handling batch construction with consistent answer preservation and variant grouping for advantage computation.

modules.name: Reward Function
modules.description: Rule-based reward evaluation that compares model-generated answers against ground-truth answers, supporting numerical comparison with format tolerance and optional format-correctness partial rewards.

modules.name: GRPO Core Module
modules.description: Base Group Relative Policy Optimization implementation including rollout generation, within-group reward standardization, policy gradient estimation, and clipping-based objective, serving as the foundation for DIVA-GRPO extensions.

modules.name: Local & Global Advantage Computation
modules.description: Dual advantage estimation: local advantage computed via standard GRPO normalization within responses to a single problem variant, and global advantage computed across all responses in the full variant set for a given original problem.

modules.name: Advantage Normalization & Difficulty-Weighted Balancing
modules.description: Batch-level z-score normalization applied separately to local and global advantages to make magnitudes comparable, followed by difficulty-weighted scaling using exponential rescaling based on relative difficulty deviation from group mean, amplifying correct signals on hard variants and penalizing incorrect signals on easy variants.

modules.name: RRB-Rescaling Module
modules.description: Reward-range-based advantage rescaling that scales normalized advantages by the ratio of actual reward spread to maximum possible reward range within each rollout group, preventing minor reward differences from producing inflated advantage signals.

modules.name: DIVA-GRPO Training Pipeline
modules.description: Complete training loop integrating dynamic difficulty assessment, adaptive variant sampling, local-global advantage balancing, difficulty-weighted scaling, and RRB-rescaling into the GRPO policy update, with epoch-level difficulty recalibration and gradient-based optimization.

modules.name: Evaluation & Benchmark Testing
modules.description: Automated evaluation across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks using standardized scoring protocols, comparison against closed-source, open-source base, and fine-tuned baseline models, generating comprehensive accuracy tables.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Systematic component ablation infrastructure supporting controlled removal of adaptive variant generation, difficulty weighting, RRB-rescaling, and global-local balance, enabling quantitative analysis of each component's contribution.

modules.name: Efficiency Analysis Module
modules.description: Measurement and comparison of training efficiency metrics including steps to optimal performance, wall-clock time per step, time per token generation, average response length, and end-to-end speedup ratios against baseline GRPO.

modules.name: Visualization & Logging
modules.description: Training dynamics visualization including accuracy curves, 3D kernel density estimation of difficulty-advantage joint distributions across training stages, non-zero advantage ratio tracking, and integration with experiment monitoring tools.
